answer: In a decentralized proof-of-agent blockchain, karst-like stake-slashing mechanisms deter Sybil threads by imposing steep penalties, ensuring that an attacker cannot economically justify multiple identities. Terrace-based verifiable delay functions further enhance security by demanding a consistent, prohibitive time and computational commitment. These defenses collectively sustain Byzantine Fault Tolerance across autonomous agents, rendering Sybil attacks infeasible due to strict negative expected utility and substantial capital lockup.
